{{Quote|I am Chief Engineer Olum. I ran the engineering team until Captain, excuse me, Grand Admiral Sait decided the Empire wasn't the place for him. I am the only one of the dissenting officers that wasn't thrown out an air lock. I guess they figured they might need me some day.|Chief Engineer Olum|<ref name="SWG:SD" />}}
'''Olum''' was a [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He served aboard [[Blackguard (Star Destroyer)|''Blackguard'']], an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] commanded by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Andal Sait]]. He was involved in the schemes of a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Ubis Reendorr]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|That's what I said. Clear out the thruster compartment, there's a radiation leak we have to lock down in there!|Olum|<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|cardname=Chief Engineer Olum}}</ref>}}
[[File:Olum.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Chief Engineer Olum aboard the ''Blackguard'']]
At some point Olum was contacted by Reendorr, who needed to smuggle a Rebel agent aboard ''Blackguard''. Olum found the Rebel, smuggled aboard inside a cargo container with a shipment of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], and provided him with Imperial uniforms and a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] with the ship's layout. The Rebel got himself into a firefight with Imperials, but was able to get what he came for. Olum covered his escape by pointing him the way to a nearby [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and adjusting the ship's transponder, which allowed the agent to escape the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].<ref name="CotF">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Chief Engineer Olum was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Olum was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Lost Star Destroyer|"Star Destroyer" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:SD" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|"Chapter 8" update]], on [[January 15]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref>
